parameters.name: UseMulticolor
parameters.description: Add color to the model

parameters.name: UseGridfinityBase
parameters.description: Include a gridfinity base inside the basket?

parameters.name: GridSize
parameters.description: Gridsize

parameters.name: Padding
parameters.description: Padding between edge of gridfinity base and the basket walls

parameters.name: WallThickness
parameters.description: Wall Thickness of the Basket

parameters.name: AdditionalFloorHeight
parameters.description: Additional floor height added to the bottom of the basket.

parameters.name: SolidFloor
parameters.description: Solid floor? Requires AdditionalFloorHeight > 0 to work

parameters.name: MagnetDiameter
parameters.description: Diamenter of the magnets. If set to zero, no magnet holes will be created. Increase this value to add some tolerance for magnet insertion.

parameters.name: MagnetHeight
parameters.description: Height of the magnets. If set to zero, no magnet holes will be created. Increase this value to add some tolerance for magnet insertion.

parameters.name: AddMagnetChamfer
parameters.description: Add additional chamfers around magnet holes to help with insertion

parameters.name: WallPattern
parameters.description: Wall Pattern

parameters.name: PatternSize
parameters.description: Pattern feature size

parameters.name: PatternTopDist
parameters.description: Minimum distance from the top of the pattern to the start of the stacking lip

parameters.name: PatternBotDist
parameters.description: Minimum distance from the bottom of the pattern to the baseplate

parameters.name: PatternSideDist
parameters.description: Minimum distance from the pattern sides to the start of the basket outer corner

parameters.name: PatternMinDist
parameters.description: Minimum distance between patterns

parameters.name: GridPatternRadius
parameters.description: Outer radius of grid pattern (has no effect on other patterns)

parameters.name: AddHandle
parameters.description: Add a handle to the sides of the basket

parameters.name: HandleWidth
parameters.description: Width of the handle

parameters.name: HandleHeight
parameters.description: Height of the handle

parameters.name: HandleCornerRadius
parameters.description: Radii of the corners on the inside of the handles

parameters.name: HandleBorder
parameters.description: Minimum border around the handle. The border may be larger to accommodate the wall pattern.

parameters.name: Standoff
parameters.description: How far down a basket reaches into a basket under it. Increasing this value decreses wiggle when stacking baskets.

parameters.name: TopPadding
parameters.description: extra room between top of any bin and bottom of another basket stacked on top

parameters.name: XYTolerance
parameters.description: XY tolerance (leave as-is in most cases)

parameters.name: ZTolerance
parameters.description: Z tolerance (lave as-is in most cases)
